requirements:
Implement in Rust as a SINGLE source file that compiles with `rustc --edition 2024`, std only. Output ONLY the Rust source code inside ```rust fences.

All listed types, functions, and struct fields must be public. All structs/enums derive Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq. Names are nonempty, case-sensitive opaque strings, compared using Rust String ordering. Input package names are unique; do not validate this precondition. Dependency lists may be unsorted and repeated. Do not mutate the inputs.

Exact public API:
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct Package { pub name: String, pub dependencies: Vec<String> }
pub fn install_order(packages: &[Package]) -> Vec<String>;

All dependency names exist in the catalog and the graph is acyclic (input preconditions). All catalog packages are relevant, including isolated packages. Return an installation order containing each relevant package exactly once, dependencies before their dependents. Repeated edges count once for ordering. At EVERY step choose the lexicographically smallest package among all currently ready packages (including newly ready packages); this is not a DFS postorder or a batched layer order. Empty relevant graphs return an empty vector.
